name: Generic Docker Application
description: Run any HTTP, TCP or UDP application from a Docker image with a persistent volume and console access.

install.script:
set -e
cat > start.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
echo "Generic Porgous server started. Edit start.sh in the file manager."
while true; do sleep 3600; done
EOF
chmod +x start.sh
echo 'Install complete'

notes: The image's entrypoint runs unchanged; the startup command runs as a shell command in the container.
